MATCH (o:Owner)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT o,
  CAST(date_part('year', DATE('2026-10-14')) AS INT64) - CAST(date_part('year', DATE(o.birth_date)) AS INT64) - CASE
    WHEN CAST(date_part('month', DATE(o.birth_date)) AS INT64) > CAST(date_part('month', DATE('2026-10-14')) AS INT64)
      OR (CAST(date_part('month', DATE(o.birth_date)) AS INT64) = CAST(date_part('month', DATE('2026-10-14')) AS INT64)
        AND CAST(date_part('day', DATE(o.birth_date)) AS INT64) > CAST(date_part('day', DATE('2026-10-14')) AS INT64))
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
  END AS age
WHERE age < 65 OR o.nationality <> 'Israeli-American'
RETURN age AS col1, o.name AS col2, o.nationality AS col3, o.name AS name_manager

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT o,
  CAST(regexp_extract(o.birth_date, '[0-9]{4}', 0) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
  CASE
    WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'january' THEN 1
    WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'february' THEN 2
    WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'march' THEN 3
    WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'april' THEN 4
    WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'may' THEN 5
    WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'june' THEN 6
    WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'july' THEN 7
    WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'august' THEN 8
    WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'september' THEN 9
    WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'october' THEN 10
    WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'november' THEN 11
    WHEN lower(o.birth_date) CONTAINS 'december' THEN 12
    ELSE CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
  END AS birth_month,
  CASE
    WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64)
    ELSE 1
  END AS birth_day
WITH o, 2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE age < 65 OR o.nationality <> 'Israeli-American'
RETURN age AS col1, o.name AS col2, o.nationality AS col3, o.name AS name_manager
